title: mjmirza/app-store-compliance
lede: app-store-compliance is a playbook and shell-script guard that scans an iOS or Android project for known App Store and Google Play rejection risks before submission.

points: It documents 117 rejection patterns, each mapped to the guideline involved and its fix.
The guard reads a project without changing it, lists critical findings first, and ends on BLOCKED, CLEAR or NOT CHECKED.
It checks privacy manifests and Data safety declarations and tracks 95 regulatory deadlines, including the EU AI Act, DSA and COPPA.
An installer wires the guard into Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, Copilot and other agent tools as a hook that stops uploads while a critical risk stands.
A plain checklist covers the account and listing steps a code scan cannot see.

points.text: Windows is the clearest gap: open bugs report scripts calling python3 literally, install.sh failing to parse, and data read with the wrong encoding.
Much of the tracker is regulatory deadlines still being added, from the EU AI Act in December 2026 to Utah's app store law in 2027.
Items left unverified by a September 2026 gap analysis still need checking against primary sources.
